reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
The steps are to select your video clips, but then you are forced to select a music tract, only then can you go on to editing mode (I didn’t want a background music track, furthermore, there are no American Standards songs, no country options, etc.). I looked but couldn’t find how to prevent a music track from playing in the background. The jingle repeats and is psychotically bad. I needed to hear the dance instructor explain the steps but could hear this due to the music track. 

I then wanted to edit down to size the correct size video clip to make a flowing dance routine. I couldn’t get it to display all the clips that I entered in the right order. It was challenging to understand the method of splicing and cutting video strips. Without all the clips being shown in the order, I couldn’t determine the right order. It seemed as if it rotated the clip order randomly, but I couldn’t tell what order they were in. 

I couldn’t figure out how to add a title page with this so I can read the title name, date, etc. 

Got tired of wasting my time and wrote this. 

I had hoped there was a better video editing app than the current go-to Videoshop app. I am deleting this app.

reviews.title: No new features for years!
reviews.text: This app doesn’t add anything new for years! The version updates is just copy and pasted recycled information. The effects don’t apply even when the music beats hard, it just doesn’t work.

reviews.title: Makes phone slow
reviews.text: The app was amazing been using it for years, however for the past month the app now whenever I hit save it gets stuck and I have to restart my phone I have to do this several times until the video is finally saved. It's a shame because the app was working perfect for years I don't know what the developers are doing with it and yes I'm paying monthly for the plan I have.
